name: The Minefields

VERSION 1.8.0 (30.09.2026)

LIMITED TIME HALLOWEEN EVENT!
HALLOWEEN THEMED MAP!

A slow-paced, tense twist on Classic Minesweeper.
Realistic, gritty and unforgiving. Survive the system and prove your worth.
Includes singleplayer story mode, multiplayer with custom modifiers, challenges and more!

[WARNING] This game contains flashing lights.

It's recommended to play this game on a PC/Console with headphones for the best experience.
